summary:
Ref origin/claude/vyakti-cloning-platform-aq05n4@ebe16cc0 (2026-09-30) is Vyakti, the expert/person AI platform (knowledge + personality + voice + private relationships + memory + sharing), and it is a superset of origin/main, voice-cloning, ai-companion-app, gurukul-platform, every gurukul-ws-* branch, codex/vyakti-completion and handoff206 (0 commits of theirs missing). The only newer work elsewhere is origin/codex/multimodal-layer-20260927 (19 commits: Group-AI portable layer, multimodal claim evidence, Honcho notes) plus small handoff side branches.
The 23-commit delta over codex/private-voice-requests25 (2026-09-21 -> 09-30) rebuilt the creator workbench UI (pearl workbench design), personal auth, private text rehearsal with a person (HumanOS) projection, and finished an account-private Hindi voice vertical slice: services/private-voice CPU consumer, migration 172 vy_private_voice_run, exact-revision GPU activation under a USD 1 planning budget, an independent Azure watchdog Job, protection (disclosure + PerTh + C2PA) before create-only storage. It was deployed enabled on 2026-09-29 but no real signed-in user has generated or listened to a sample; voice likeness, English and realtime voice remain unbuilt or unmeasured.
The 241 commits since the multimodal fork (2026-09-09) removed the Meera surface (liveCall.ts, components, echosim) and added HumanOS person sheets (163), EmotionOS register + five-dial vibe (164) with a prosody mapper, RelationOS in the Room, per-sentence voice sequencing (5.00x faster first audio), text-ready Meet (167), owner continuity (170), listening test, Vyakti Capacitor flavour + OTA, Hindi studio, and many release-gate repairs.
Context tail entries record the real Azure gpt-5.6-terra canary (191/49 tokens, 3218 ms), the credit-only GPU approval and the billing-guard gap (spending limits Off, LimitRemoved, balance unreadable), the owner's waiver, the Honcho assessment (adopt ideas: context card, facts vs hypotheses, correction-aware consolidation; no dependency), and process lessons (CSP killed uploads, fixture races, shared npm cache, Job-name limits).
For Taxila the highest-value reusable assets are not the cloning stack but: the minor safety floor (clock.ts hard gates, honesty gate + Childline 1098, one-door gatedReply, material detector, safety-floor-teacher spec, expert FLOOR text), the pedagogy core (TeacherSheet doubt ladder/analogy pairs/mistake bank, syllabus-as-data, mastery fold with no decay, observation-vs-pattern evidence bars, student-app gamification rejections), affect primitives (register reader, EXPRESSION_FEATURES, prosody bands, vibe dials), learner communication contract, memory authority/consolidation with leases and metered extraction, fail-closed provider spend ledger, Azure-only serving + Foundry adapter, release gates, Android OTA and WAV capture, and the measured gpt-realtime-2.1-mini rejection (monologue length, voice/accent, no frame channel) which directly informs Taxila's realtime choice.
Gaps for Taxila: no avatar, no generative UI/module generation, no covert comprehension detector, no learning-modality profile, no gpt-realtime integration, no gpt-image usage, no human-validated voice quality anywhere in the repo.

rejections.tried: gpt-realtime-2.1-mini (Azure) as the voice-call brain with an unchanged prompt.
rejections.what_broke: Monologue length (41-53 words/turn, 14 s turns), weak Hinglish ('doesna nahi chahiye'), no plausible Indian ~266 Hz voice, no continuous frame channel; latency and barge-in were fine.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila's chosen realtime family: budget turn length in the tutor prompt, ear-test voices for Indian accent, plan frames as discrete items.

rejections.tried: Moving the voice to Azure coral TTS because every measured axis improved.
rejections.what_broke: Owner's ear: not human, not Indian. Battery measured pronunciation, not accent identity.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Make accent authenticity a first-class axis in Taxila voice selection.

rejections.tried: stream:true on the paid OpenRouter TTS lane.
rejections.what_broke: Accepted and does nothing; synthesis is buffered then flushed.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Verify streaming with first-byte vs complete timing before relying on it.

rejections.tried: Example quotes and polished sentences in the persona brief.
rejections.what_broke: Recited verbatim (4/5 turns; taste echoed twice eight turns apart; register defection).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Tutor sheets must be shapes/facts; never sample lines a tutor could recite to a child.

rejections.tried: Enforcing honesty (no invented email/address/receipt) with a well-written persona bullet.
rejections.what_broke: Rule sat 38.6% into the brief; mid-brief rules fire 0/8; she claimed a resume arrived in a mailbox she does not have.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Decide decidable properties on output bytes (no fake homework 'submitted', no invented teacher relay).

rejections.tried: A second hand-assembled realtime prompt beside compile().
rejections.what_broke: Dropped FORGET_DECISION and AGE_TIER_SAFETY_OVERRIDE; a minor's romance-register refusal never reached the realtime lane.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One assembler for text and gpt-realtime instructions; assert floor per lane.

rejections.tried: UPDATE-only writers for relationship state.
rejections.what_broke: Zero rows ever existed for 40 users; relational surface silently invisible.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Every Taxila table needs a named first-row owner; derivers upsert.

rejections.tried: Accumulating more call audio into the voice reference to 'learn' the voice.
rejections.what_broke: Chatterbox conditions on first 10 s/6 s only; synthesis cannot change while the ECAPA meter rises.
rejections.taxila_relevance: A pipeline whose inputs grow is not one that learns; read consumer truncation before building accumulation.

rejections.tried: Blinding a listening bench by filename/order only.
rejections.what_broke: Every clip spoke 'This is an AI-generated voice replica' first; operator check would unblind the only listener.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Ask what the shipping path adds to an artifact before benchmarking it.

rejections.tried: Native Hindi TTS then OpenVoice V2 tone-color conversion to owner timbre.
rejections.what_broke: ECAPA fell 0.727->0.681 and WER rose 0.304->0.375.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Avoid cascaded timbre conversion for tutor voice.

rejections.tried: Synthesising each Hindi/English token run separately and crossfading; identity-anchor preset as default voice.
rejections.what_broke: Every switch reset prosody/breath; clip 3.36x longer with 65% near-silence; anchor preset sounded flat and robotic.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never stitch code-switched speech per language; one utterance per sentence.

rejections.tried: Calling structural code-switch passes, a curated orthography table or higher ECAPA a quality win.
rejections.what_broke: Checks do not listen; owner still heard robotic and wrong switches.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Only blind human ratings certify voice quality.

rejections.tried: Using an unmatched setup (unknown language -> effective CFG 0) as the voice baseline.
rejections.what_broke: Did not reproduce the measured identity-anchor clips; test referenced a nonexistent wire field.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Baselines must match the exact measured configuration.

rejections.tried: Claiming automatic background memory after merging the consolidation code.
rejections.what_broke: Deployed env lacked the sweep/model variables and previews do not run Vercel cron.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Prove the deployed scheduler runs before claiming per-child memory consolidation.

rejections.tried: Studio CSP connect-src 'self' with uploads to Azure Blob and no media-src.
rejections.what_broke: Upload refused after a 201 authorization; blob playback 0:00; UI showed only 'Paused'. Vite fixtures lacked production headers.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Run real-header browser counterfactuals for any recording/upload flow.

rejections.tried: Treating green CI gates and an owner-pinned sample as product completion.
rejections.what_broke: Owner on phone could not upload; overlapping capture UI, sticky notices, raw status strings.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Acceptance is a real device journey, not fixtures.

rejections.tried: Patch-only redesign of the September-21 interface.
rejections.what_broke: Owner rejected it despite passing fixtures; no clear full workflow.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Design the whole journey for kids/parents up front; verify signed-in states at 390/1440.

rejections.tried: Green-tinted cream landing and a spinning 'scanning YOU' orb.
rejections.what_broke: Read as a policy document with dead gaps; technical metaphor did not explain the next action.
rejections.taxila_relevance: One visible next action per screen.

rejections.tried: 60-second liveness capture auto-stop.
rejections.what_broke: voice-evidence identity_audio.py refuses frames beyond 30 s.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Align client capture caps with server decoder limits.

rejections.tried: First text-ready reply calling the generator directly.
rejections.what_broke: Returned not_metered; bypassed the shared spend ledger.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Every model call (first-turn included) through the spend ledger.

rejections.tried: Sending the visible browser transcript back as conversation history; auto-reusing older consent rows.
rejections.what_broke: Client text becomes trusted history; one-question attestation broadened after the fact.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Server-held encrypted history only; consent is prospective and scoped.

rejections.tried: Reusing the public C2PA/generation path for private runs; splicing absent-table references into erasure SQL.
rejections.what_broke: Public genome contract unsatisfiable; Postgres resolves an absent table even behind a false predicate; a single 10-min lease could expire mid paid write.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Catalog-gate optional tables; renew leases per stage.

rejections.tried: Treating Sponsored quota id, a USD 1 app cap or cost alerts as no-charge proof.
rejections.what_broke: Spending limits Off/LimitRemoved; 5,000 is an initial amount; balance unreadable (401/403).
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila Azure credits need provider-side protection; app caps are planning only.

rejections.tried: Interpreting nonempty encrypted Vercel env values as usable config / asking owner to paste secrets.

rejections.taxila_relevance: Read secrets via exact per-variable endpoints or vault; never by pasting.

rejections.tried: Releasing fixture holds on a click return.
rejections.what_broke: Node24 races: list released before request arrived; global mode switched before GET.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Use HTTP arrival barriers in browser tests.

rejections.tried: Asserting a recorder guard by its exact JSX source spelling.

rejections.tried: Deploying with the shared npm cache.
rejections.what_broke: npm ECOMPROMISED lock error before deployment creation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Project-local npm cache for deploys.

rejections.tried: 33-character Container Apps Job name; API redeploy without source metadata; reusing Vercel transport for Azure probe.
rejections.what_broke: Azure 400/GET 404; install guard failed; origin guard refused before transmit.

rejections.tried: Assuming Azure Personal Voice was the live voice provider.

rejections.tried: Whole-word padding that strips combining marks for Devanagari.
rejections.what_broke: Matras shattered words; Hindi laughter 'हाहा' misread as rushed.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Keep \p{M} in any Indic text normaliser.

rejections.tried: Installing Honcho / sending conversations to Honcho cloud because its site suggests it.
rejections.what_broke: Third-party content is not permission; AGPL; benchmarks vendor-reported; Neuromancer weights not verified for Azure.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Evaluate memory ideas on own data before any dependency.

rejections.tried: Voice frontier shortcuts: Fish S2 Pro as open-commercial, Qwen3 as Hindi-ready, newer Hindi pack auto-loads via generic example, high-frequency energy as identity.
rejections.what_broke: Primary licenses/language lists contradict; aliases move.

rejections.tried: Persistent audio cache keyed by text+style only.

rejections.taxila_relevance: Any cached tutor audio/embedding key must include voice/model identity.

rejections.tried: Device-keyed retrieval legs while identity is person-keyed.

rejections.taxila_relevance: Key child memory by child id, never device/surface (web vs Android).

rejections.tried: Mining every uploaded file/link/chat export as the owner's own words.

rejections.tried: @resvg/resvg-js for Hindi share cards.

rejections.tried: Adopting PhoneLLM on B200 benchmark numbers.
rejections.what_broke: English text model, 63 GB BF16, no Hindi, cost from 88-process utilisation.
rejections.taxila_relevance: Vendor benchmarks on other hardware do not transfer.

rejections.tried: Model candidates: luna/terra for vision; terra as 8x cost saving; Sarvam/Indic models on Foundry; open-weight models.

rejections.tried: Gamification: speed bonuses, XP for streak length, XP for asking doubts, notification re-engagement, Duolingo-style leagues.

rejections.tried: Auto-filling boardVerbalisms from mined lecture frequency.

rejections.taxila_relevance: Human picks catchphrases; held-out corpus prunes.

concepts.name: Structural beats behavioural
concepts.description: If a property is decidable from the bytes, decide it on the bytes; prompt rules leak 57-98%, SQL predicates 0/31,122.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child safety, privacy and academic integrity as predicates on output and retrieval, not tutor-prompt sentences.

concepts.name: Shapes, never lines
concepts.description: Prompt material is telegraphic facts and shapes; any sentence-shaped text is recited.
concepts.taxila_relevance: TutorSheet, lesson plans and learner-profile notes must be shapes.

concepts.name: Position is mechanism
concepts.description: Only the appended-last slot reliably fires (0/8 vs 8/8); capped to two rules by shapelint.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Reserve the last slot for the minor safety override and the current pedagogical move.

concepts.name: The one door
concepts.description: All model text leaves through gatedReply; static test asserts a single call site.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Single egress for tutor text; realtime audio needs input-side fences and post-hoc transcript audit.

concepts.name: Pull-only, never stored affect
concepts.description: Register/moment reads are pure functions of the current turn, rendered only at high confidence, never persisted as a label.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Covert comprehension/affect signals adapt the next move without building a stored emotional profile of a child.

concepts.name: Expression features not emotions
concepts.description: Closed list of measurable delivery features (latency, pauses, backchannels, rate, pitch), 24 h expiry, no inner-state claims.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Basis for covert comprehension detection: hesitation/latency/backchannel patterns, not 'the child is confused' labels.

concepts.name: Observation vs pattern evidence bars
concepts.description: One citation recalls a detail; a generalising pattern needs >=2 citations, >=3 support, >=2 distinct days.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning-profile claims ('learns best via stories') must clear pattern bars before steering lessons.

concepts.name: Facts vs hypotheses (Honcho-inspired)
concepts.description: Store what was said separately from tentative interpretations; hypotheses suggest questions, never become facts.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learner model: observed outcomes vs inferred learning style hypotheses under test.

concepts.name: Today-only vs durable preference
concepts.description: Current-turn override adapts this reply without rewriting the saved preference; permanent change supersedes with provenance.
concepts.taxila_relevance: 'Aaj Hindi mein samjhao' must not overwrite the child's saved English preference.

concepts.name: No decay by absence
concepts.description: Mastery is a pure fold of graded attempts; nothing reads time since last attempt.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A child returning after a break is never shown a lower mastery number.

concepts.name: Minor hard gates short-circuit
concepts.description: Minor branch returns a frozen constant before any config is read; unknown tier fails safe.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Every Taxila user is a minor; no flag can enable engagement mechanics.

concepts.name: Disclosure as app voice, failure toward disclosing
concepts.description: Statutory AI disclosure fires from the client clock even offline, MAX(local, server).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Session-open 'I am an AI tutor' card and break nudges independent of the model.

concepts.name: Disclosure acts with deny-always-wins
concepts.description: influence/gist/paraphrase/verbatim acts, policy-versioned grants, exclusive expiry, named refusals.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent visibility granularity (gist of progress vs verbatim transcript) as an evaluated grant.

concepts.name: Fail-closed spend ledger
concepts.description: Reserve before network I/O, settle measured usage, unknown outcome stays reserved; app caps are not invoice caps.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Per-child/day caps on realtime minutes, text tokens and image generations.

concepts.name: Warming is a state
concepts.description: Cold resources return 202 with retry rather than an error.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated-module and image generation latency surfaced as an honest in-lesson state.

concepts.name: Inputs that grow are not learning
concepts.description: Read the consumer's truncation before building accumulation (Chatterbox 10 s/6 s).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Do not assume longer session history in the prompt means the tutor learns; measure retrieval.

concepts.name: What does the shipping path add?
concepts.description: Production safety features (spoken disclosure) can be bench defects.
concepts.taxila_relevance: When evaluating tutor voices, account for disclosure/watermark artifacts.

concepts.name: Caps are refusals, never trims
concepts.description: Silent truncation ate the crisis helplines once; over-budget prompts/items are refused with numbers.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Prompt budget gate for tutor prompts; refuse oversized uploads explicitly.

concepts.name: Every table has a first-row owner
concepts.description: relstate-zero-rows: updates against rows nobody inserts silently do nothing.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learner profile/mastery tables need explicit seeding owners.

concepts.name: Identity in every cache key
concepts.description: Persisted audio/embeddings must carry voice/model identity in the key.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Cached tutor audio and TTS clips keyed by voice id + model version.

concepts.name: Memory keyed by person, never surface
concepts.description: Device-keyed retrieval lost 89% of recall on surface switch.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Web and Android sessions of the same child share memory by child id.

concepts.name: Attribution before mining
concepts.description: Text about a person is not evidence of how they talk; only a human can say who wrote it.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Uploaded textbooks are content, not learner evidence.

concepts.name: One utterance per sentence for code-switching
concepts.description: Per-language token stitching destroys prosody; one Hindi-conditioned utterance per sentence keeps it.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Hinglish tutor speech: synthesise per sentence, never per language span.

concepts.name: Accent authenticity is its own axis
concepts.description: Pronunciation correctness and sounding Indian/human are different properties.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Tutor voice selection must include Indian-accent and child-friendliness ratings by ear.

concepts.name: Fixtures are not journeys
concepts.description: Green CI and pinned samples did not prove a phone user could upload.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Acceptance = real child/parent device journeys at 390 px, real headers, real network.

concepts.name: Activities ride one relationship
concepts.description: Every activity is an adapter producing facts + nameable identifiers on the same prompt/memory.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated lesson modules and mini-games plug in as activities, keeping tutor continuity across chat, call, and module.

concepts.name: Interview gaps as shapes
concepts.description: Rank what the profile lacks and hand the model a question shape, never a question.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning-profile discovery inside lessons without test-like quizzing.
